raw_response: {"sentences":[{"text":"Settle in.","source_id":"GLUE_PACING","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":0},{"text":"You're starting in Midtown, right in front of Grand Central Terminal — so take a second and just look up.","source_id":"SYNTHESIZED_OPENER","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Start with the 42nd Street facade.","source_id":"GLUE_STAGING","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":0},{"text":"What crowns it is The Glory of Commerce, called America's greatest monumental sculpture — forty-eight feet of it, designed by the French sculptor Jules-Félix Coutan, carved across the river in Long Island City by Donnelly and Ricci, then hoisted up piece by piece in 1914.","source_id":"f2fd4e4b-edc8-4091-8c94-e3e274893569","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"At its center a wing-capped Mercury, Roman god of travel and commerce, throws his arms wide in welcome, while Hercules lounges beside him in a strangely placid pose and Minerva, ancient guardian of cities, gazes down on the mayhem of 42nd Street.","source_id":"f2fd4e4b-edc8-4091-8c94-e3e274893569","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0,"also_cites":["551ad8f6-7250-41ff-92df-b180bb851d33"]},{"text":"Its base is Connecticut Stony Creek granite, its upper stretch Indiana limestone.","source_id":"f2fd4e4b-edc8-4091-8c94-e3e274893569","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"And that clock beneath Mercury's foot is the largest single piece of Tiffany glass anywhere in the world.","source_id":"f2fd4e4b-edc8-4091-8c94-e3e274893569","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0,"also_cites":["551ad8f6-7250-41ff-92df-b180bb851d33"]},{"text":"The architects were thinking like Romans, who once framed the entrances to great cities with monumental arches meant to awe everyone passing through; they saw railroad terminals as exactly that kind of gateway and filled this one with the symbols of imperial Rome.","source_id":"551ad8f6-7250-41ff-92df-b180bb851d33","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Ten colossal fluted Doric columns tower over Park Avenue to prove the point.","source_id":"551ad8f6-7250-41ff-92df-b180bb851d33","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"None of it was guaranteed — when the original Penn Station opened across town and threatened their railroad, the Vanderbilt dynasty tore down Cornelius Vanderbilt's 19th-century Grand Central Depot and rebuilt it as a 20th-century showpiece.","source_id":"2e3f1af7-b16a-4e32-9fd0-3348f123df61","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"You'll find the old tycoon himself out front, a statue of Cornelius Vanderbilt beneath the great central window.","source_id":"88da7f30-4365-441a-8cd0-0ffdf615ed42","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Two hundred buildings came down to make room, and when the doors opened on February 2, 1913, the bill ran to eighty million dollars.","source_id":"65c200a8-1eeb-4aea-88bd-600288b548bc","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"What they got was beaux-arts — steel, granite and limestone — and still the most breathtaking building of its kind in New York.","source_id":"2e3f1af7-b16a-4e32-9fd0-3348f123df61","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0,"also_cites":["88da7f30-4365-441a-8cd0-0ffdf615ed42"]},{"text":"Step into the Main Concourse and it hardly feels like somewhere you'd catch a train — more a glorious ballroom.","source_id":"8d8ae4cf-a11f-404f-b995-c5a427780617","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Terry Gilliam saw it too; the closing scene of his 1991 film The Fisher King turns this very floor into a ballroom of waltzing commuters.","source_id":"d5229645-0d00-4163-a681-d553bc50237f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"That floor is Tennessee pink marble, an acre of it, with vintage ticket counters cut from Italian Bottocino marble.","source_id":"8d8ae4cf-a11f-404f-b995-c5a427780617","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0,"also_cites":["65c200a8-1eeb-4aea-88bd-600288b548bc","88da7f30-4365-441a-8cd0-0ffdf615ed42"]},{"text":"Electric light was one of the station's proudest tricks, so bare bulbs still glow along the walls and across the massive chandeliers overhead.","source_id":"65c200a8-1eeb-4aea-88bd-600288b548bc","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Now look up — nine stories up — to a vaulted turquoise and gold-leaf sky, where the constellations of the zodiac shine out of 59 fiber-optic lights scattered among 2,500 painted stars.","source_id":"65c200a8-1eeb-4aea-88bd-600288b548bc","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0,"also_cites":["8d8ae4cf-a11f-404f-b995-c5a427780617","88da7f30-4365-441a-8cd0-0ffdf615ed42"]},{"text":"Study it and you'll notice the eight constellations run backwards.","source_id":"8d8ae4cf-a11f-404f-b995-c5a427780617","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"A mistake? Apparently not.","source_id":"8d8ae4cf-a11f-404f-b995-c5a427780617","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Its French designer, the painter Paul César Helleu, wanted the stars shown from God's point of view — from the outside looking in.","source_id":"8d8ae4cf-a11f-404f-b995-c5a427780617","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Moisture later forced a faithful repaint by Charles Gulbrandsen in 1944, and when the architects Beyer Blinder Belle restored the ceiling they left one small rectangular patch of soot in the northwest corner, beneath the crab, as a marker of how filthy it had become.","source_id":"8d8ae4cf-a11f-404f-b995-c5a427780617","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Before you leave, find the Whispering Gallery on the vaulted landing below the bridge that links the Concourse to Vanderbilt Hall.","source_id":"9d99248f-7f46-48a5-b5ff-20dd23b12617","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Put a friend in the arched corner diagonally across from you and murmur something — it carries straight to their ear.","source_id":"9d99248f-7f46-48a5-b5ff-20dd23b12617","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"People propose here, a lot, and if the answer's yes, chilled champagne waits right through the door at the Grand Central Oyster Bar, under a tiled vaulted ceiling by the Catalan engineer Rafael Guastavino — with an elevator beside it climbing to a snootier old gem, the bar called The Campbell.","source_id":"9d99248f-7f46-48a5-b5ff-20dd23b12617","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0}]}
